profile.summary: The San Diego County Office of Education is the public education agency for San Diego County, California. It is led by the county superintendent of schools, who is appointed by the county board of education. The office provides educational leadership, runs programs and services for school districts and schools, reviews and approves district budgets, and operates its own schools.
